The principles of '''Sword, Plow, and Spirit''' were a series of lessons that [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Michael Tandre]] taught the [[Kentra|indigenous species]] of [[Orellon II]] when he crashed on their home planet.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref>

The Kentra would eventually move on to create an entire religion based on these teachings.<ref name="TP" />
